lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's San Miguel County BOCC meeting, where three Land Use Code amendments go to public hearing — including changes to who qualifies as an 'owner' under housing rules and a wildfire-area code update, both the kind of thing that shapes this valley for years. The Open Space Commission meets Monday to settle on a preferred trail alignment for the Valley Floor River Trail, with three wetland-sensitive options in play. Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes up several multifamily projects Thursday, and the Ouray County Planning Commission holds a virtual work session Wednesday on definition changes to their land use code.

notable.stake: Commissioners pick which River Trail alignment crosses Valley Floor wetlands.
